//: MERGE these keys into ~/.claude/settings.json (user-level) or a project .claude/settings.json. PREFER ./install.sh — its merge strips every '//'-comment key first. If you merge BY HAND, DELETE all '//' keys: user/project/local settings are validated STRICTLY (a file that fails validation is rejected as a whole — docs/en/settings), so stray keys can silently kill every hook. Assumes statusline/ and hooks/ are at ~/.claude/cost-control/ and chmod +x'd.
//dynamicWorkflowSize: As of v2.1.219 this IS a settings key: uncomment workflowSizeGuideline below (unrestricted|small|medium|large). It takes precedence over /config -> Dynamic workflow size and hides that row. Default is medium (<15 agents). Advisory only -- Claude Code sends it to the model as advice, not an enforced cap.
//subagentFanoutEnv: Platform ceilings, not set here: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS (default 20, NOT enforced in ultracode sessions) and CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH (default 3 layers; set 1 to disable nesting). The 200-spawns-per-session cap was REMOVED in v2.1.224 -- nothing bounds lifetime spawn count anymore.
//managedSettings: For the belt-and-suspenders hard model gate, also hand-place managed-settings.snippet.json at your OS managed-settings path. See that file (and its note on the fable lead-session tradeoff).
//subagentModelEnv: Do NOT set CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL globally — it OVERRIDES frontmatter (docs/en/model-config). Leave unset (frontmatter governs). Use it only tactically for one heavy session.
//spawnGating: Verified vs code.claude.com docs 2026-07-16: a subagent spawn IS a PreToolUse call on the Agent tool (renamed from Task in v2.1.63; Task still aliases), and PreToolUse is the ONLY hook surface that can block it (JSON permissionDecision deny). SubagentStart fires on spawn but CANNOT block (context-injection only) — registered below for audit logging. TaskCreated is the task-LIST event (TaskCreate tool), unrelated to spawns — deliberately NOT registered. Run tests/test-hooks.sh offline, then the cost-control-verify self-test live.

env.//: Optional — uncomment to stream telemetry to the local Grafana stack (dashboard/). Restart Claude Code after changing.
